all.source_quote: Applicant must be at least 18 years old

unmodelled.text: Project must be a new micro‑enterprise in manufacturing or service sector
unmodelled.source_quote: New enterprises only: Scheme is applicable only for new projects; existing units are not eligible

unmodelled.text: Project cost thresholds for education requirement (Rs 10 lakh manufacturing, Rs 5 lakh service) are not modelled
unmodelled.source_quote: Minimum 8th pass required for projects costing above Rs 10 lakh in manufacturing sector Rs 5 lakh in service/business sector

unmodelled.text: Sector must be manufacturing or service/trading units
unmodelled.source_quote: Eligible sectors: Only manufacturing and service sector projects are covered

unmodelled.text: Units already availing subsidy under other government schemes are not eligible
unmodelled.source_quote: Units already availing subsidy under other government schemes are not eligible

unmodelled.text: Certain institutions (private limited companies, partnership firms, large enterprises) are generally not eligible
unmodelled.source_quote: Institutions like private limited companies, partnership firms (in some cases), and large enterprises are generally not eligible

ambiguous: The education requirement is conditional on project cost, but the cost is not expressed in the schema; no numeric condition can be created for it
